notes.subject: פרק
notes.rationale: Occurs only here in the Tanakh — 'broken pieces/broth of meat', rendered 'hap hap mit'.

notes.subject: ובנצורים
notes.rationale: 'In the guarded/hidden places' — graves-vaults (JPS), monuments (KJV), desert ruins (Targum); necromantic lodging implied by context.

notes.subject: פגלים
notes.rationale: Ceremonially fetid offerings, rendered 'samting tambu' — ritual uncleanness, not mere disgust.

translation: Ol i stap long ol graun bilong ol man i dai pinis, na long ol ples hait ol i slip; ol i kaikai mit bilong pik, na hap hap mit bilong samting tambu i stap long ol kalik bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: long ol graun bilong ol man i dai pinis
